food_insecure_share_qc.status: PLACEHOLDER until sources/fnri_food_security.csv is present; then the weighted Quezon City value from the DOST-FNRI ENNS Food Security PUF
food_insecure_share_qc.source: DOST-FNRI ENNS Food Security Survey public use file. Used ONLY to set households_served = catchment_households x share. Changed 2026-10-12: no longer multiplied into need, because pantry clients are already food-insecure households (multiplying again double-counted the share).

catchment_households_min.source: Assumed number of households within walking distance that a small pantry could register

catchment_households_max.source: Assumed number of households within walking distance that a small pantry could register

turnout_min.unit: share of served households expecting food on a given evening
turnout_min.source: Assumed; not every registered household comes every evening

turnout_max.unit: share of served households expecting food on a given evening
turnout_max.source: Assumed; not every registered household comes every evening

kg_per_household_evening.unit: kg per household that turns up
kg_per_household_evening.source: Assumed supplementary portion (about one ulam serving per household); rescued food tops up, it does not replace, a household's meals

share_pantries_with_fridge.source: Assumed; small community pantries often lack refrigeration

supply_ratio_min.source: Salo study guide, page 13 (food supply fixed before tuning)

supply_ratio_max.source: Salo study guide, page 13 (food supply fixed before tuning)

speed_kmh_motorcycle.source: Assumed evening traffic speed in Cubao (plus 3 min handling)
